facts.fact: PMS-SC is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme of the Ministry/Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, implemented through the States and UTs
facts.quote: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is implementing the Centrally Sponsored Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste students through State Governments and Union Territory Administrations.

facts.fact: Parents'/guardians' income from all sources must not exceed Rs 2,50,000 a year, counted for the last financial year
facts.quote: 5.3 Scholarships will be paid to the students whose parents’/guardians' income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/- (Rupees Two lakh Fifty thousand only) during the last Financial Year.

facts.fact: The income certificate is needed only once, at admission, for courses lasting more than one year
facts.quote: Income certificate is required to be taken once only i.e. at the time of admission only to courses which are continuing for more than one year.

facts.fact: The income certificate is issued by the authority the State Government decides
facts.quote: The income certificate shall be issued by the Authority as decided by the State Government.

facts.fact: These guidelines were issued in March 2021 and apply from 2020-21, running up to FY 2025-26
facts.quote: FOR STUDIES IN INDIA (2020-2021 to 2025-26) GOVERNMENT OF INDIA MINISTRY OF SOCIAL JUSTICE & EMPOWERMENT Department of Social Justice & Empowerment (March, 2021)
facts.note: Scanned PDF read by OCR. PIB release of 07-09-2026 (PRID 2307396) shows the scheme still being implemented; no notice revising the Rs 2.5 lakh ceiling for 2026-27 was found.

facts.fact: Funding is shared 60:40 between Centre and States (90:10 for North-Eastern States)
facts.quote: The scheme is funded on a 60:40 Centre–State sharing basis, and 90:10 for North-Eastern States.

facts.fact: Applications go through the designated State scholarship portal or the National Scholarship Portal
facts.quote: Applications under the Scheme are invited through designated State scholarship portals or the National Scholarship Portal.

summary: All PMS-SC facts confirmed (Rs 2.5 lakh ceiling, certificate once, 60:40, State portal/NSP); PIB 07-09-2026 shows the scheme continuing with no revised ceiling.
